title: Weak limit of tangential derivatives of smoothed Lipschitz cut-offs on one C¹ chart piece (proof of Simon Ch. 6, 4.5(2), (1) and (4))
statement:
Let P, n ∈ ℕ. Let V ⊆ ℝ^{n+1} be open and ψ : ℝ^{n+1} → ℝ^P be C¹ on V and injective on V, with Dψ(y) injective for y ∈ V. Let C ⊆ V be compact, Y ⊆ C Borel, and F : ℝ^{n+1} → ℝ C¹. Let f : ℝ^P → ℝ be L-Lipschitz with f(ψ(y)) = F(y) for y ∈ Y. Let G : ℝ^P → ℝ^P be Borel with, for every y ∈ Y, G(ψ(y)) ∈ Dψ(y)(ℝ^{n+1}) and ⟨G(ψ(y)), Dψ(y)e⟩ = DF(y)e for all e.
Let a < b and γ(s) := min{1, max{0, (b − s)/(b − a)}}. Let (h_k)_{k∈ℕ} be C¹ functions ℝ^P → ℝ with ‖Dh_k(x)‖ ≤ c for all k, x, converging uniformly on ℝ^P to γ∘f. Let w : ℝ^P → ℝ be integrable on ψ(Y) with respect to H^{n+1} = μHE[n+1]. Let W : ℝ^P → ℝ^P be Borel with |W| ≤ c', such that for H^{n+1}-a.e. x ∈ ψ(Y), W(x) ∈ Dψ(y)(ℝ^{n+1}) for the y ∈ Y with ψ(y) = x. Then
 lim_{k→∞} ∫_{ψ(Y)} w(x)·Dh_k(x)[W(x)] dH^{n+1}(x) = ∫_{ψ(Y)∩{a<f<b}} w(x)·(−(b − a)⁻¹⟨G(x), W(x)⟩) dH^{n+1}(x)
(Bochner integrals).
